title: Isomorphic Strings
description: Determine if two strings are isomorphic by mapping characters one-to-one.

data.text: Two strings `s` and `t` are isomorphic if the characters in `s` can be replaced to get `t`. Each character must map to exactly one character, and no two characters may map to the same character.

data.title: Bidirectional map O(n)
Map + Seen set O(n)
What improved?
data.text: One map plus a `used` set prevents two characters from mapping to the same target. Simpler logic with the same O(n) runtime.
